description: Implementation of an FFmpeg-based audio decoder class specialization, including codec initialization, decoding, and resource management.

classes.name: AudioDecoderImpl<FFMPEG>
classes.description: FFmpeg specialization of the AudioDecoder implementation, handling initialization, decoding, and resource management for audio streams.

methods.name: GetSupportedSampleType
methods.description: Determines the supported audio sample type based on sink support.

methods.name: GetFfmpegCodecIdByMediaCodec
methods.description: Maps media stream info to corresponding FFmpeg codec ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the FFmpeg audio decoder.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up callback functions for output and error handling.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes input buffers into audio frames, handling different FFmpeg API versions.

methods.name: ProcessDecodedFrame
methods.description: Processes a decoded AVFrame into a DecodedAudio object and queues it for output.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream, queues EOS marker.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio frames from the queue.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is properly initialized and valid.

methods.name: GetSampleType
methods.description: Returns the sample type based on codec context.

methods.name: GetStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type (interleaved or planar) based on codec context.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Allocates and configures the FFmpeg codec context.
